# Bartosz Marcin Wróblewski

**Mathematician • Quantitative Developer • Software Engineer**

Quantitative software developer and mathematician with ~8 years of industry experience
across front-office derivatives valuation, market risk modeling, and software
engineering. Combines a strong theoretical foundation in differential equations with
hands-on delivery of production valuation engines, risk orchestration platforms, and
developer tooling for global financial institutions.

### [DXC Luxoft](https://www.luxoft.com/industries/banking)

::: {.resume-header}

[Senior Software Developer]{.resume-title} [Sep 2024 -- Present]{.resume-date}

:::

Senior engineering consultant in a G-SIB bank's Risk & Compliance group, supporting a
Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk (CCR) system migration to Acadia Open Source
Risk Engine (ORE).

- Technical lead for a cross-functional team of 2 software engineers and 3–5 quants,
  establishing system architecture, coding standards, and automated code review gates.
- Partnered with a senior quant to design and build an internal benchmark pricing model
  for callable bonds in QuantLib (evaluating 1-factor vs. 2-factor short-rate models),
  replacing legacy vendor software.

  portfolio-specific features, including piecewise-constant parameterization and call
  notice period mechanics.
- Built a fixed-income data translation pipeline (Pydantic, Polars, Pandera) converting
  raw Bloomberg bond data into canonical portfolio JSON schemas.
- Designed the GitLab CI/CD testing pipeline and a cross-tool AI agent harness bridging
  Devin and Codex with reusable skills, custom linters, and Zensical documentation
  standards to ensure analyst contributions adhere to production standards.

::: {.resume-tech}
